Added `SprintStories/EN-xx-goals-to-objectives/final_merge_check.py`.

It:
1. Collects **active** signals across workspaces
2. Samples **10** at random, preferring different workspaces
3. For each, loads `targeting.history/{date}/{signal_id}.parquet` for a **recent** run (within 1 day, lookback up to 3 days if writes are sparse) and one **older than 7 days** (iterates S3 date folders)
4. Compares **treatment proportions** and **probability means** (`conv_prob` / `counterfactual` / …)
5. **Warns** when mismatch > 1%
6. Writes results to `data/final_merge_check_<timestamp>.csv`
